$meta.name: current
$meta.source: current — Brand Guide v1.0 · identity spec
$meta.note: Single source of truth. src/styles/tokens.css and brand/assets/*.svg are GENERATED from this file by `npm run brand:build`. Edit here, never there.

display.stack: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
display.usage: Wordmark and headlines ONLY. The characterful face stays rare so it always feels intentional.

ui.stack: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
ui.usage: Interface and body — everything that is not the wordmark or a headline.

wordmark.clearspace: Equal to the height of the 'c' (x-height) on all four sides.
wordmark.iconFallbackBelowMin: Drop the amber wave, keep the C only.

rules: Maintain full clearspace around the mark.
Use the water gradient on dark, or the deepened gradient on light.
Let the spark be the only warm accent — one per view.
Fuse the t-crossbar and current line as one path in final art.
Never respell it — no dropped vowels, no K, no caps.
Never stretch, skew, or rotate the wordmark.
Never recolor it outside the palette.
Never add shadows, outlines, glows, or bevels to the type.
Never place it on busy imagery without a scrim for contrast.

voice.tone: Energetic, of-the-moment, community-first. Talks like a scene, not a corporation — direct, warm, a little electric.
